preconditions.description: The dimensions of the grid must be between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == m for s in grid)
preconditions.description: Each row of the grid must have exactly m characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'WB' for s in grid for c in s)
preconditions.description: Each character in the grid must be either 'W' or 'B'.

postconditions.description: The output must be the smallest number of coins required to achieve the favorite coloring.
